## About Me 

Hello, I'm a graduate student in MHS Epidemiology at Johns Hopkins University Bloomberg School of Public Health. I am passionate about using data to improve public health outcomes. My current interests lie in injury prevention and spatial analysis. I have some background in R and Python. In my free time, I enjoy cooking, reading, and crafting.
